## Send me an email

I am always happy to talk about animal communication—whether you have a research question, a strange plot, a method you are trying to make work, a possible collaboration, or simply something you found exciting.

You do not need a polished proposal or a formal introduction. A short email saying hello and telling me what caught your interest is enough. If you already have a species, dataset, or question in mind, feel free to include it, but that is not a requirement.

::: {.contact-welcome}
**The easiest way to reach me:** [nakul@princeton.edu](mailto:nakul@princeton.edu)
:::
